name: Benyamin Bolhassani
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer / AI Engineer
description: Full-stack software engineer with 6+ years shipping scalable web applications — social networks, CRMs, automation systems, accounting platforms, and reservation APIs. I'm fluent at uncovering what a product owner actually needs, learning the domain fast, and turning it into clean, modular, well-architected systems. I build AI agents and AI-augmented workflows into how I work and ship — and I treat slow queries and heavy pages as bugs to be fixed.

projects.title: Eventoment
projects.description: Social platform for local events. Built the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and the Nuxt.js frontend — and led the team shipping it.
projects.longDescription: Eventoment is a social networking platform designed for organizing and discovering local events. As lead developer, I drove the build of the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and the Nuxt.js frontend, and cut a critical flow from roughly 900 database queries down to about 30 through eager loading and query optimization — work that, alongside Webpack bundling, raised the platform's SEO to an A score.

projects.title: Safar 360
projects.description: Travel-booking platform. Built the multi-tenant ticketing core that powers selling agencies across air, rail & bus.
projects.longDescription: Safar 360 is a comprehensive travel-booking platform covering flights, trains, hotels, and tour packages. I built the multi-tenant ticketing core used by selling agencies to manage inventory and sales across air, rail, and bus — wiring it into multiple travel-service providers and payment gateways for a seamless booking experience.

projects.title: Steel Rizan
projects.description: Industrial-operations platform for a steel casting factory, with a custom-formula engine driving its pricing system.
projects.longDescription: Steel Rizan is an industrial-operations platform built for a steel casting factory on Laravel and Filament. At its core is a custom-formula engine that drives the pricing system, alongside production tracking, ticketing, and admin tooling tailored to the realities of steel manufacturing.

projects.title: AtiehOmid
projects.description: Dashboard for bank users and their investigators, built with Laravel, Livewire, and Filament.
projects.longDescription: AtiehOmid is a dashboard product serving bank users and the investigators who work with them. It's built on the Laravel · Livewire · Filament stack, with a focus on clear data presentation and fast, dependable workflows for financial review.

projects.title: Azar PMR
projects.description: Operations platform with per-cell custom formulas, built with Alpine.js on top of Filament & Laravel.
projects.longDescription: Azar PMR is an operations platform that needed spreadsheet-like flexibility inside a structured admin panel. I built per-cell custom formulas with Alpine.js on top of Filament and Laravel — giving operators the calculation freedom of a spreadsheet with the reliability of a real application.
features: Per-cell custom formula engine in Alpine.js

projects.title: OnYar
projects.description: Health & disease content platform built on a nwidart modular architecture with per-module testing.
projects.longDescription: OnYar is a health and disease content platform built on a modular architecture using nwidart/laravel-modules, with each module carrying its own test suite — making the codebase easy to extend without breaking what already works.

brain.title: A shared 'Rules' framework for AI-augmented teams
